description:
PURIS® is a leader in plant-based protein, sourcing peas directly from trusted North American farmers and producing high-quality, fully traceable ingredients in the USA. Our Clear Protein Stick Packs combine 7g of pea protein with electrolytes and functional ingredients in a refreshing, clear drink that mixes easily with water—no shaker or blender required.

Affiliates earn 15% commission on every qualifying sale with a 30-day cookie window, while their audience receives 20% off their first order with code CLEAR20. We provide product samples, creative assets, approved messaging, and ongoing support, giving you the flexibility to promote in the way that works best for your audience.
payout_period: PLANTB has 30 days to review and approve commissions. Approved commissions are paid on the 1st of the following month once your balance reaches $25 via PayPal. Balances under $25 automatically roll over until the minimum is met.

PURIS® AFFILIATE PROGRAM TERMS & CONDITIONS

Welcome to PURIS®! Thanks for joining our Affiliate Program (the “Program”).

These following terms and conditions apply to PURIS as a merchant (“we” or “PURIS”) and individuals who are accessing or using the Program as an affiliate (“you” or “Affiliate”) who refers customers to use products or services from PURIS.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approve or Reject the Affiliate Program Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated once PURIS approves the Affiliate Program Registration. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours before purchasing PURIS® products, yours is the one that counts.

PURIS may send you coupon codes in the future.  If a coupon code is provided, the applicable terms and usage details will be displayed in the Dashboard. You will receive only one commission per sale. If customer both clicks on the Affiliate link AND uses coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. You may only promote a coupon if given to you by PURIS.

Affiliate may also advertise the PURIS website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, etc., or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on net order value including discounts, and not including extra fees (tax, shipping cost, etc.).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings on the UpPromote platform. Payment schedule will be published on Affiliate Guide page on the platform.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives PURIS the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission is displayed in Commission tab on the UpPromote platform, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.  Commission on a returned or refunded order will be reversed.

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through the Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on Affiliate channels.

5.  Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them. If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay you a commission on that person's activity.

Cookies thirty (30) day attribution window is outlined on the Affiliate Registration form. The first tracking day will be the day a customer clicks on the Affiliate’s link or uses the coupon. Every order made by this customer during the specified cookie attribution period at PURIS’ website will automatically result in commissions to the Affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the Affiliate link then). If a customer clicks on your link at a later time, the Cookies attribution window restarts.

6. Removal from Referral Program

If an Affiliate wishes to be removed from the Affiliate Program, it can do so by contacting: affiliates@purisfoods.com.

7. Prohibited Activities

Affiliates must not engage in fraudulent activities, spam, or misrepresent our products or services.

Affiliates cannot bid on “PURIS,” “PURIS Foods,” misspellings/variations, product names, or other PURIS trademarks in Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, etc. They also shouldn’t use PURIS trademarks in display URLs/domain names or impersonate an official PURIS ad.

We explicitly prohibit affiliates from using their own link/code for personal purchases or purchases made on their behalf.

PURIS logos, product photos, trademarks, etc. can only be used for promoting the Program and can't be materially modified in a misleading way.

8.  Sensitive Traffic Sources Policy:

Affiliates must not promote the PURIS website or PURIS® products through the following sensitive traffic sources without prior written approval:

  • Adult content websites or platforms
  • Illegal content or file-sharing sites
  • Sites promoting violence, hate speech, or discrimination
  • Gambling or betting platforms
  • Cryptocurrency or high-risk investment promotions


GO FORWARD AND REFER!!!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to affiliates@purisfoods.com for support.

PRIVACY POLICIES

PURIS® Privacy Policy
PURIS respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. Our Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard personal information when you interact with PURIS, including through our websites, communications, and business relationships. Please review the PURIS Privacy Policy here: https://shop.puris.com/policies/privacy-policy

UpPromote Privacy Policy
PURIS utilizes UpPromote to administer its Affiliate Program. In connection with the Program, UpPromote may collect, process, and store certain Affiliate information, including registration details, payment information, and referral tracking data, on PURIS' behalf. UpPromote's handling of personal information is governed by its Privacy Policy, which is available at: https://docs.uppromote.com/privacy-policy/privacy-policy.

Contact information

If you have any questions about your personal data or this Privacy Policy, or if you would like to file a complaint about how we process your personal data, please contact us by email at affiliates@purisfoods.com

Acknowledgment. By participating in the Affiliate Program, you acknowledge that you have reviewed the applicable privacy policies and understand that your personal information may be processed as described therein.
